usedFor: Trint produces transcripts and HubSpot holds deals, so “Verified Transcript” can feed “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Verified Transcript” in Trint, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A verified transcript is final, so the deal is updated only once the text is approved.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID, so carry it over from wherever the transcript started.
